ios.desc:
Welcome to DayPlus. We make counting down days and events easy. Customize the countdown to perfectly suit your needs with backgrounds, colors, and reminders. Keep track of your countdowns on the app, lock screen, and home screen. You can even import and sync calendar events.

Highlights:
• Quickly create and track countdowns for goals, trips, births, weddings and other important events.
• Customizable event balls and cards
• Reminders for each countdowns
• Sync Calendar items into DayPlus
• Share event countdowns with friends and family
• Track all countdowns on the timeline
• Light and dark mode
• Repeat countdowns every day or week
• Pin important events
• Easy sorting

Download DayPlus now! Counting down days and events just got easy. Customize, sync, track, and share countdowns on your app, lock screen, and home screen. Don’t miss any important event - Set reminders and stay organized. Let the countdown begin!

Do you have suggestions? Contact us at hlai.manjun@gmail.com

Privacy Policy: https://manjun.tech/doc/en/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://manjun.tech/doc/en/user-agreement.html

quotes.text:
I'm excited to share with you all an app I've been working on, called DayPlus – a fresh take on countdown apps. Instead of the usual list view, DayPlus represents your upcoming events as dynamic spheres that respond to the passage of time, growing or shrinking as the event approaches, complete with gravity effects.

What sets DayPlus apart? It's not just a visual gimmick; the sphere design is a more intuitive representation of time, providing a quick, at-a-glance way of understanding how much time is left until an event. You can even set it to track anniversaries or past events and have them repeat yearly.

I'm here for your thoughts and feedback. What do you look for in a countdown app? Any particular features you'd love to see in the next update?

Try DayPlus and join me in reimagining the countdown experience: DayPlus[https://apps.apple.com/app/id6463768562].

Thank you for your time and insight – I look forward to reading your comments and suggestions!
quotes.story_title: Rethink How You Countdown to Life's Big Moments
